create_logger_with_file_and_console_hand: create a logger with file and console handlers using create_logger with a filepath and process rank
create_log_formatter_with_elapsed_time: create a LogFormatter instance that formats log records with level name, timestamp, and elapsed time
create_pd_stats_tracker: create a PD_Stats object to track and persist statistics as a pickled pandas DataFrame
update_pd_stats_with_row: update a PD_Stats tracker with a new row of data and optionally save to pickle file
reset_logger_elapsed_time: reset the logger elapsed time by calling the reset_time method attached to the logger
